kicker: HOEGH OSAKA · SOLENT, UK · PART 2 OF 2
caption:
PART 2/2 — The stability calculation started after she sailed. ⚠️🚢

At 21:09 Hoegh Osaka loses her stability in the West Bramble turn. At 21:15 she grounds on Bramble Bank with a 40° list. Cargo breaks loose, about 2,700 t of seawater floods in, and the crew wait for helicopters through the night.

MAIB: stability must be calculated after loading and before sailing — with real weights and real soundings.

What would you have done? 👇

Source: MAIB report 6/2016 (public report). Photos: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen). Animated illustration, not a reconstruction.

scenes.narration: Sixteen hundred vehicles. Twenty-five people. And the departure stability calculation... starts only after she sails.
scenes.direction: Fast and tense, then slow on the last line.

scenes.headline: [Previously...]
scenes.narration: Previously... extra cargo, a list at the berth, a late stability check. And now... the turn.
Twenty-one oh nine. At just twelve degrees, she loses her stability. Hard a-starboard! Stop engines! She rolls... possibly as far as sixty degrees.
scenes.direction: Shout the orders. Then slow and heavy on 'sixty degrees'.

scenes.headline: [21:15] Aground. 40° list.
scenes.narration: No steering. No propulsion. Twenty-one fifteen. She grounds on the Bramble Bank, forty degrees to starboard. The pilot phones V T S: keep her on the bank.
scenes.direction: Breathless, then calm and firm on 'keep her on the bank'.

scenes.headline: Below decks: [chaos].

items: Cargo breaks loose, shifts to starboard

scenes.narration: Below, cargo breaks loose. A digger's tracks pierce the hull. Falling cargo breaks a deck. Two thousand seven hundred tonnes of seawater gets in.

scenes.headline: Escape [in the dark].

items: 5 climb out of the engine room
1 falls 18 m — arm and leg broken

scenes.narration: Five men escape the engine room. One falls eighteen metres and breaks an arm and a leg. Two jump into the sea. At oh two oh nine, the last three are airlifted off.
scenes.direction: Serious, steady. Relief on 'All twenty-five survive'.

scenes.narration: The investigators wrote it plainly. Unsafe practices had become the norm.

scenes.headline: What the [MAIB] found.

items: No departure stability calculation before sailing
Cargo weights estimated, cargo centres of gravity ignored
Ballast gauges dead, tank levels estimated
Not enough stability for a 12-knot turn

scenes.narration: The M A I B found: no departure stability calculation before sailing. Cargo weights estimated, their heights left out. Ballast quantities estimated. Not enough stability for a twelve-knot turn.

scenes.headline: [Lessons] for every ship.

items: Stability is calculated before the lines come off
Use real weights and real soundings
A strange list at the berth is a warning

scenes.narration: Lesson one. Calculate stability before the lines come off. Lesson two. Real weights, real soundings, not estimates. Lesson three. A strange list at the berth is a warning... find out why.
scenes.direction: Firm, like a senior Chief teaching juniors.

scenes.narration: Now tell me... what would you have done at that berth? Comment below. And follow Jai Marine Shorts for the next case file.
